en.title: Results of 2026 elections in Alcântara (MA): voting for president at Escola Municipal Professora Rosita Cerveira Marques, in the 52nd electoral zone

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro consolida apoios na direita e no centrão enquanto Lula sobe tom contra STF e mira quem não votou

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro consolidates support from right and center-right as Lula intensifies tone against Supreme Court and targets non-voters
en.summary: The PL's presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro received backing from right-wing and center-right figures following his first-round election lead. Lula escalated criticism of the Supreme Court and focused on voters who abstained.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro busca Republicanos para ampliar onda de apoios no 2º turno

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro seeks Republicans to expand wave of support in runoff
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign is pursuing the backing of the Republicans party, led by federal deputy Marcos Pereira from São Paulo, with expectations to formalize the party's support during the week.

stories.title: Zema declara apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no segundo turno; veja o vídeo

en.title: Zema declares support for Flávio Bolsonaro in runoff; see the video
en.summary: Governor Zema publicly announced his endorsement of Flávio Bolsonaro for the runoff election.

stories.title: As agendas econômicas de Lula e de Flávio Bolsonaro são muito fracas, diz Meirelles

en.title: The economic agendas of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are very weak, says Meirelles
en.summary: Meirelles criticized both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, characterizing their respective economic proposals as inadequate.

stories.title: Honda testará recarga de veículos elétricos em movimento

en.title: Honda to test wireless electric vehicle charging while driving
en.summary: Honda and construction company Taisei plan to conduct highway demonstrations of wireless charging technology for electric vehicles in fiscal year 2027 or later. The technology could enable smaller batteries in electric vehicles, potentially reducing costs and increasing adoption.

stories.title: Paes acusa ‘manobra’ para eleger Ruas no 1º turno e chama Garotinho de ‘candidato laranja’

en.title: Paes accuses 'maneuver' to elect Ruas in first round and calls Garotinho 'dummy candidate'
en.summary: Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial candidate Eduardo Paes accused rivals Anthony Garotinho and Douglas Ruas of orchestrating a coordinated strategy to prevent a second-round runoff. Paes made the allegations after Garotinho withdrew his appeal against his candidacy rejection.

stories.title: Em reunião com Lula, aliados prometem reduzir abstenção e sugerem até aumento de selfies

en.title: In meeting with Lula, allies promise to reduce abstention and suggest even increasing selfies
en.summary: President Lula met with political allies to coordinate second-round campaign strategies, focusing on reducing voter abstention in the Northeast and Southeast regions. Allies proposed diversifying messaging and increasing the candidate's digital presence, an area where Lula has shown resistance.

stories.title: Nunes Marques quer julgar anulação da pena de Bolsonaro depois do segundo turno

en.title: Nunes Marques wants to judge annulment of Bolsonaro's sentence after second round
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques intends to postpone judgment of former president Bolsonaro's request to suspend his 27-year sentence for attempted coup until after the election runoff. The case will require a full court decision rather than a preliminary ruling.

stories.title: Ex-pesquisador da Anthropic diz que IA traz riscos que a própria indústria ainda não compreende

en.title: Ex-Anthropic researcher says AI poses risks the industry itself does not yet understand
en.summary: Jacob Coxon, a former Anthropic researcher, testified before New York City lawmakers that the artificial intelligence development race involves risks the industry has not fully grasped. He stated that current systems lack adequate control mechanisms.
